\(33^{13}\equiv 26\pmod{211}\).

Part B: Simulating monthly transactions, fees, and 0.5% interest gives a final balance of \(4893.75\).

Part C: Total draws \(\binom{12}{3}=220\). All different colors: \(5\cdot 2\cdot 5=50\).  
Probability at least two share \(=1-\frac{50}{220}=\frac{17}{22}\).

Part D:
